  "demoplus/agent-notes/compare-warm-perf-vs-dp.txt: q06 GPU_SCAN Computing 9.27 -> 7.57 s (-18%) and Queued 16.9 -> 12.9 s while wall +44%: the late scan runs alone and is 25-35% faster per fragment (431/437/412 ms vs 568-659 ms concurrent), the B7 contention effect seen from the other side",
  "source: perf/experimental/starrocks/src/compute_node_service.rs:207-297 reads SIRIUS_CN_ASYNC_SENDER_DISPATCH and documents this exact q06 wave; grep -rn ASYNC_SENDER_DISPATCH demo-plus/experimental/starrocks/src is empty; demo-plus compute_node_service.rs:271-292,592-624 exec_plan_fragment -> exec_single_attachment -> process_inline runs the fragment on the RPC's blocking task; git branch --contains 9a5a4da6 lists only the three fix/* branches, not demo/q1q6-integration-plus-fixes",
  "second-order effect (demoplus/agent-notes/percn-q03-r1.txt): q03 second-wave leaf senders start at 1145 ms on all four dp CNs after the slowest first-wave RPC closed at 1101 ms (idle=932 ms = scan + drain), vs per-CN 1091/1100/1142/1168 ms in the baseline; q03 warm +8% (1607 -> 1730 ms), q04 +7%"
 ],

Sum of the 15 warm means: baseline 21.08 s vs demo-plus 22.36 s (+6%), q06 alone +0.37 s.",

}

"""Per-CN fragment timeline for one run: every 'fragment run started/finished' (role, cn, elapsed), exec_plan_fragment RPC closes

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(f"{arm}/runs/runs.csv")))
def ts(x): return datetime.datetime.strptime(x[:26].rstrip('Z'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f').replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()
win = None
for i, r in enumerate(rows):
    t0 = ts(r['start_utc']); t1 = ts(rows[i+1]['start_utc']) if i+1 < len(rows) else t0 + float(r['ms'])/1000 + 5
    if f"{r['query']}.r{r['run']}" == want: win = (t0, t1, r)
